text_block_list.text: On the last day of summer camp, she said...

"I'll perform well enough to win
the Best Dirt Umamusume award,
and once I win it, I'll turn it down!" she said...

The day of the Champions Cup.
Shinko Windy was mulling over her top-secret grand prank operation.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If we don't win an award, our prank will be a failure...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Which means...! I absolutely have to win!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"When I win the award, I want to look
so cool that nobody could possibly complain!"

—At the pre-race press conference,
she was surrounded by more reporters
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy! You've been drawing a lot of attention after your splendid performance in the Teio Sho the other day, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
How are your preparations going?
The public is increasingly saying, "Wait, isn't she actually strong...?!"—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... ♪
Calm down, you guys. Line up one at a time, I say.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That is, if ya wanna know the secret
to the strength of the baddest, strongest Umamusume, Windy-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Talk about a big mouth living up to the rumors.
She's got quite an incredible aura...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
A "new generation" has been on the rise in dirt races lately,
but is that something you are conscious of?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: A new generation...? Come to think of it, I feel like I've heard about that.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "If I recall, they were saying stuff like 'the one from Funabashi is strong' or 'the Chestnut Visitor from Morioka is...' or something like that."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I heard there are some local circuit Umamusume
getting a lot of attention lately...

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Hey... speak of the devil.
Sounds like they're in the audience...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?!
I'd definitely love to get a comment from them.
I gotta go interview them too—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! You guys...!
To a bunch of people who just came to watch...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Gnnnngh~~~! The new generation, you say~~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! It's Windy-chan's turn to run today!
Look over here more, I saaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan is definitely stronger, nanoda!
Dammit, just you watch, nanodaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wah... as expected of a self-proclaimed 'Villainous Umamusume'...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... "The 주목 (noteworthy) bad Umamusume
is poised to become a towering wall for the new generation"... it says.
Yeah, this is going to make for a fantastic feature article...!
Shinko Windy's attitude remained unchanged, but the atmosphere among the reporters had clearly shifted.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa, what a huge crowd!
It's super lively☆
I'm so glad I came all this way♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What wonderful energy...♪
That just shows how much everyone is paying attention.
To Windy-san's true ability...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, for the sake of her ambitions,
I'm sure Windy-san can show us
no end of amazing runs...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fuhoo...! Somehow, it's making my own heart pound too...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai will... definitely pull it off!
I bet everyone's jaw is gonna drop!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's all cheer with everything we've got!
So Senpai's ambition can come true...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Shinko Windy~!
Do your best! We're expecting big things from you today--!
I heard she's strong... I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun... Everyone, everyone's looking at me.
Their gazes are a little different than before...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
I mean, maybe they're strong, but...
that's only "for a joke character", right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(...Seems there're still just a few folks
who don't appreciate Windy-chan's greatness yet, but...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm going to teach every single one of them a lesson once and for all...!

The crowd watches her with intense focus.
Wondering... is that strength the real deal?

The excitement is high enough.
Now is the time to show my power...!
The Champions Cup is about to begin—!
